name: Alcalá de Ebro (Spain)
description: Divided by a red band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, blue at the lower hoist and upper fly, charged at the centre with a yellow castle.
history: Municipal flag of Alcalá de Ebro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly
